environment: real-employee-auth preview with strict-TLS disk-backed remote retopology simulator
notes: The browser uploaded a real parseable FBX to the server; no local triangle simplifier was used or exposed.
The server connected to the simulated remote worker over HTTPS using a generated CA whose PEM SHA-256 was pinned for that preview process.
The browser restored and parsed the SHA-verified formal FBX after both the LI3D server and remote worker simulator were restarted.
This proves the remote boundary, delivery contract and recovery behavior in simulation; it does not prove the production topology algorithm quality or production CA/service deployment.
